shellCommands.command: /bin/bash -lc "cat package.json && printf '\\n--- routing ---\\n' && sed -n '1,100p' .agents/skills/gravity-ui/references/package-routing.md && printf '\\n--- app ---\\n' && cat src/App.tsx && printf '\\n--- main ---\\n' && cat src/main.tsx"

/bin/bash -lc "ls node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/docs 2>/dev/null | head; printf '\\n--- menu docs ---\\n'; find node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit -path '*docs*Menu*' -o -path '*Menu*.d.ts' | head -30; printf '\\n--- dropdown/menu exports ---\\n'; rg -n \"export.*Menu|DropdownMenu|MenuProps\" node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/*.d.ts node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build -g '*.d.ts' | head -80"

/bin/bash -lc "cat node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/cjs/components/DropdownMenu/DropdownMenu.d.ts; printf '\\n--- types ---\\n'; cat node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/cjs/components/DropdownMenu/types.d.ts; printf '\\n--- trigger anchor ---\\n'; sed -n '1,90p' node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/cjs/components/DropdownMenu/DropdownMenuPopup.d.ts"

/bin/bash -lc "sed -n '1,180p' node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/cjs/components/Button/Button.d.ts | sed -n '1,120p'; printf '\\n--- traps button ---\\n'; rg -n -C 3 \"Button|DropdownMenu|view\" .agents/skills/gravity-ui/rules/hallucination-traps.md | head -80"

/bin/bash -lc "printf '%s\\n' '--- current ---'; cat src/App.tsx; printf '%s\\n' '--- updated ---'; cat /tmp/App.tsx.updated 2>/dev/null || true; printf '%s\\n' '--- diff raw ---'; diff -u src/App.tsx /tmp/App.tsx.updated 2>/dev/null | head -40 || true"

/bin/bash -lc "sed '/const \\[isMenuOpen, setIsMenuOpen\\] = useState(false);/d; /import { useState } from /d; /open={isMenuOpen}/d; /onOpenToggle={setIsMenuOpen}/d' src/App.tsx > /tmp/App.tsx.simplified
diff -u src/App.tsx /tmp/App.tsx.simplified > /tmp/app.diff || true
cat /tmp/app.diff
git apply /tmp/app.diff
mv /tmp/App.tsx.simplified src/App.tsx
npm run build"

/bin/bash -lc "git apply -p2 /tmp/app.diff
mv /tmp/App.tsx.simplified src/App.tsx
npm run build
printf '\\n--- result ---\\n'
cat src/App.tsx"

/bin/bash -lc "sed '/"'^$/{ N; /''^'"\\n"'$/D }'"' src/App.tsx > /tmp/App.tsx.clean
sed -i 's/action: () => {},/action: () => undefined,/g' /tmp/App.tsx.clean
diff -u src/App.tsx /tmp/App.tsx.clean > /tmp/app-clean.diff || true
git apply -p2 /tmp/app-clean.diff
mv /tmp/App.tsx.clean src/App.tsx
npm run build"

/bin/bash -lc "printf '%s\\n' '--- clean ---'; cat /tmp/App.tsx.clean 2>/dev/null || true; printf '%s\\n' '--- diff ---'; cat /tmp/app-clean.diff 2>/dev/null || true; printf '%s\\n' '--- status ---'; git status --short"
